verdict.rationale: All evidence describes New Relic as a cloud-hosted SaaS platform (agents forwarding data to New Relic's servers, cloud dashboards, cloud-hosted API); there is no documentation of a self-hosted deployment architecture or upgrade path, and one community comment explicitly notes on-prem APM alternatives are underserved, implying New Relic doesn't fill that role. Missing for 10: any self-hosted/on-prem deployment docs, architecture diagrams, or upgrade/versioning guidance for running the stack outside New Relic's cloud.
